description: Starts an EdgeCloud image generation from a prompt and returns the image. Charges credits per image, only on success; price it with quote. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

max_price_credits.description: The most you'll pay for this call, in Wave credits. Needed unless you pass quote_id; the call fails if the price is higher

prompt.description: What to draw, up to 1,000 characters

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by quote (valid 5 minutes, single use). Use instead of max_price_credits

name: image_generate
title: Generate an image
